description: Render index data as a Mermaid diagram (returned in a ```mermaid fence — paste into GitHub markdown, docs, or a Mermaid viewer). kind=imports: workspace import graph, file-level with directory clusters or collapsed to directories (granularity, path_prefix to scope). kind=calls: call graph around one symbol (direction in/out/both, depth). kind=types: inheritance diagram around one type. kind=call_path: shortest call chain from one symbol to another (from_name/from_id -> to_name/to_id). Dotted arrows are low-confidence structural edges (< 0.70) — hints, not facts.

depth.description: calls/types: levels to expand from the symbol

direction.description: calls: callers, callees, or both. types: subtypes, supertypes, or both.

granularity.description: imports: file-level, directory-level, or auto (dir when the file graph exceeds max_nodes)

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

path.description: with line: innermost symbol at that position

path_prefix.description: imports: only files under this root-relative path

name: generate_diagram
title: Generate Mermaid diagram
